title: Every seeded Group event sits in its circle, and the three new circles carry placeholder meetups

source.ref: The Group handoff (2026-10-19) section E: place every event in its circle (SCAN-949), keep each series hosted by its chapter, add placeholder meetups for the new circles.

detail: The seed writes the three placement columns lib/events/placement.ts livePlacementPatch writes (scope_circle_id, scope_id, scope_type circle) on every event and its occurrences: a member-led series lands in the circle whose match word its title carries (all twelve handoff circles receive at least one series, and The Wellness Club lands in The Group Wellness), a chapter meeting lands in its chapter's Space Circle, and a network-wide event in the Network's. Tenancy (space_id, the Network) and hosting (host_space_id, the chapter) do not move, so the Space calendars and the chapter calendars read exactly as before; what changes is that each Circle page's Upcoming block now lists its own meetings, and the rows leave the regional This Week surface, which only lists public-scope standalone events (the same trade every placed event makes). The Masterminds, Wellness and Pickleball circles are now in the seed with the ids production already holds (handoff C4) and a meetup line that says June confirms the schedule; the upsert never overwrites a meetup an owner has typed, and no event with an invented date is seeded for them. Production gets the same move as section C7 of the owner's SQL paste.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const c=require('crypto');const s=fs.readFileSync('scripts/seed-the-group.mts','utf8');const q=fs.readFileSync('scripts/seed-the-group.sql','utf8');const bad=[];const A=String.fromCharCode(39);const id=k=>{const h=c.createHash('md5').update('the-group:circle:'+k).digest('hex');return h.slice(0,8)+'-'+h.slice(8,12)+'-'+h.slice(12,16)+'-'+h.slice(16,20)+'-'+h.slice(20)};const block=n=>{const a=s.indexOf('export const '+n+' = [');return s.slice(a,s.indexOf(String.fromCharCode(10)+']',a))};const keys=b=>[...b.matchAll(/key: '([a-z-]+)'/g)].map(m=>m[1]);const circles=keys(block('CIRCLES'));const fresh=keys(block('NETWORK_CIRCLES'));if(circles.length<12)bad.push('CIRCLES lost rows: '+circles.length);if(fresh.length!==3)bad.push('NETWORK_CIRCLES is not three circles');const stmts=q.split(';'+String.fromCharCode(10)).filter(x=>x.includes('insert into events (slug, title'));if(!stmts.length)bad.push('no event inserts');const off=stmts.filter(x=>!/'circle', ('[0-9a-f-]{36}'|\\(select id from circles where space_id = '[0-9a-f-]{36}' and is_space_primary)/.test(x));if(off.length)bad.push(off.length+' event inserts are not placed in a circle');if(/\\(select region_id from _tg\\), 'public'/.test(q))bad.push('an event still carries the public region scope');for(const k of circles){if(!stmts.some(x=>x.includes(A+id(k)+A+', '+A+'circle'+A)))bad.push('no seeded series placed in tg-'+k)}for(const k of fresh){if(!q.includes(A+'tg-'+k+A))bad.push('tg-'+k+' is not seeded');const at=q.indexOf('insert into circle_profiles (circle_id, meetup) values ('+A+id(k)+A);const stmt=at<0?'':q.slice(at,q.indexOf(';',at));if(!stmt.includes('June confirms')||!stmt.includes('where coalesce(circle_profiles.meetup->>'+A+'text'+A+', '+A+A+') = '+A+A))bad.push('tg-'+k+' has no guarded placeholder meetup')}if(!/scope_type = excluded.scope_type, scope_circle_id = excluded.scope_circle_id/.test(q))bad.push('a re-run would not move an existing event');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-952: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
